subject: maths
question: A pipe can fill a tank in 8 hours. Another pipe can empty the filled tank in 16 hours. If both the pipes are opened simultaneously, then the time (in hours) in which the tank will be three-fourth filled, is:
solution:
**Given:**

Filling pipe = 8 hours

Emptying pipe = 16 hours

Required = 3/4 filled

**Formula used:**

Rate = 1/time, net rate = fill rate − empty rate, Time = Work ÷ Rate

**Calculations:**

⇒ Fill rate = 1/8

⇒ Empty rate = 1/16

⇒ Net rate = 1/8 − 1/16 = 1/16

⇒ Work = 3/4

⇒ Time = (3/4) ÷ (1/16) = (3/4) × 16

⇒ Time = 12 hours

**∴ Tank will be three-fourth filled in 12 hours.**
